articles.title: Russ Allbery: Review: Ode to the Half-Broken
articles.summary: "Ode to the Half-Broken" is presented as a standalone post-apocalyptic science fiction novel. The narrative commences with its unnamed, first-person protagonist discovering themselves waking up in a bathtub within an abandoned building. This opening sets a classic tone for a survival story within a desolate future, likely exploring themes of rediscovery and human resilience amidst a broken world, a common trope in the genre.
